The Dark Side tolerates no hesitation! Choose between the sorcery of the Inquisitors or the silent wrath of the Assassins. The opposing path will be permanently sealed. Seal your fate — there is no turning back!
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_block.title: Block
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_block.desc: Unlocks right-click blocking. 35% block chance for projectiles, 50% for lightsabers.
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_better_block.de: 50% block chance for projectiles, 70% for lightsabers.
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_adv_block.title: Adv. Block
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_adv_block.desc: 70% projectile block chance, 80% lightsaber block chance.
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_throw.title: Lightsaber Throw
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_throw.desc: Unlocks lightsaber throw (Max. 12 blocks). Sweeping Edge effect: 2 blocks.
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_focusing.title: Focusing
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_focusing.desc: Unlocks the true hidden effects of your equipped lightsaber crystals.
skill.lightsabersfork.sb_adv_speed.title: Adv. Speed
skill.lightsabersfork.sb_better_throw.de: 24 blocks throw range and 3 blocks hit-range.
skill.lightsabersfork.sb_adv_throw.title: Adv. Throw
skill.lightsabersfork.sb_adv_throw.desc: 32 blocks throw range and 5 blocks hit-range.
skill.lightsabersfork.sb_ult_speed.title: Ultimate Speed
skill.lightsabersfork.sb_ult_speed.desc: Activates classic 1.8 combat mechanics (No strike cooldown!).
skill.lightsabersfork.db_adv_form.title: Adv. Form
skill.lightsabersfork.db_adv_form.desc: +0.5 blocks range, +1 base damage, 15% knockback reduction.
skill.lightsabersfork.db_single_switch.d: Allows targeted toggling of individual blades for hybrid combat advantages.
skill.lightsabersfork.db_ult_block.title: Ultimate Block
skill.lightsabersfork.db_ult_block.desc: Blocks 100% of all projectiles and 90% of all incoming lightsaber attacks.
Awakens your connection to the mystical energy field of the Force.
skill.lightsabersfork.force_adept.title: Force Adept
skill.lightsabersfork.force_adept.desc: Deepens your connection, expanding your maximum Force Energy.
skill.lightsabersfork.force_channeler.de: Refines Force flow, accelerating natural Force regeneration.
skill.lightsabersfork.force_veteran.desc: Greatly broadens Force reserves through battle and meditation.
skill.lightsabersfork.force_mastery.desc: Achieves complete mastery over raw Force energy.
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_initiate.desc: Takes the first steps following the sacred Jedi Code.
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_padawan.title: Jedi Padawan
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_padawan.desc: Trained under a master. Grants endurance and focus.
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_knight.title: Jedi Knight
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_knight.desc: A sworn defender of galactic peace and guardian of the Light.
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_librarian.des: Dedicates life to ancient Jedi wisdom. Massively boosts Force Pool and meditation.
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_guard.title: Temple Guard
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_guard.desc: An unyielding bastion. Enhances armor, knockback defense, and barriers.
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_master.title: Jedi Master
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_master.desc: Radiates an aura of serenity that sustains allies and repels darkness.
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_council.title: Council Member
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_council.desc: A pillar of the Order. The Force itself intervenes to avert fatal blows.
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_grandmaster.d: One with the living Force. Undead flee and powers cost less.
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_hopeful.title: Sith Hopeful
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_hopeful.desc: Kindles the raw fire of passion and darkness.
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_acolyte.title: Sith Acolyte
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_acolyte.desc: Channels wrath. Slain enemies grant bursts of speed and haste.
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_warrior.title: Sith Warrior
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_warrior.desc: Executes weak foes mercilessly with devastating strikes.
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_inquisitor.de: Masters dark sorcery. Lightning arcs across multiple victims.
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_assassin.desc: Strikes unseen from shadows with lethal surprise damage.
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_master.title: Sith Master
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_master.desc: Exudes an aura of dread that weakens surrounding adversaries.
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_council.title: Dark Council
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_council.desc: Kills caused by dark powers detonate in shockwaves of pure fury.
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_emperor.title: Sith Emperor
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_emperor.desc: Unlimited power! Dark arts pierce all armor and defenses.
power.lightsabersfork.force_push.desc: Channel kinetic energy to violently knock enemies backwards.
power.lightsabersfork.force_pull.desc: Create a vacuum in the Force pulling entities and items directly to you.
power.lightsabersfork.force_dash.desc: Accelerate your physical reflexes and movement in a burst.
power.lightsabersfork.force_jump.desc: Perform a powerful Force-infused leap. (Hold Sneak + Space on the ground to charge a mighty high jump!)
power.lightsabersfork.force_jump.secret: §e[Secret] Charge jump height scales with hold duration; negates fall damage!
power.lightsabersfork.force_stasis.desc: Freeze targeted enemies and suspend incoming projectiles mid-air in a field of stasis.
power.lightsabersfork.force_stasis.secre: §b[Secret] Suspends projectiles in flight and paralyzes multiple foes in a field!
power.lightsabersfork.force_slam.desc: Violently slam enemies downward into the earth with immense kinetic force.
power.lightsabersfork.force_slam.secret: §6[Secret] Crushes enemy shields and triggers devastating seismic shockwaves!
power.lightsabersfork.force_heal.desc: Harness the Light Side to rapidly repair cellular tissue.
power.lightsabersfork.force_repulse.desc: Release a 360-degree shockwave pushing all nearby foes back.
power.lightsabersfork.force_lightning.de: Unleash raw hatred in the form of devastating Force Lightning.
power.lightsabersfork.electric_judgement: Incapacitate enemies with righteous Light Side lightning.
power.lightsabersfork.force_choke.desc: Constrict the windpipe of your victim from a distance.
power.lightsabersfork.force_drain.desc: Siphon the life force of your target to replenish your own.
Lift and manipulate physical matter using the Force.
power.lightsabersfork.force_barrier.desc: Erect a barrier of pure Force energy absorbing incoming damage.
power.lightsabersfork.force_barrier.secr: §b[Secret] Deflects projectiles and expands into an impenetrable dome!
power.lightsabersfork.force_fortify.desc: Erect a barrier of pure Force energy around yourself.
power.lightsabersfork.force_sight.desc: See enemys and companions through the reality and blocks
power.lightsabersfork.force_stealth.desc: Become invisible to the mobs eyes and hide from other players
advancements.lightsabersfork.root.title: A Galaxy Far, Far Away...
advancements.lightsabersfork.root.desc: Find your first Kyber Crystal in ancient ruins, temples, or the deep underground.
advancements.lightsabersfork.crystal_pou: Craft a Crystal Pouch from leather and string to safely store all 18 Kyber Crystals.
advancements.lightsabersfork.craft_circu: Craft Lightsaber Circuitry using iron, diamonds, and redstone.
advancements.lightsabersfork.craft_forge: Construct a Lightsaber Forge out of Forcestone and iron.
advancements.lightsabersfork.first_light: Assemble your very first Lightsaber inside the forge.
advancements.lightsabersfork.double_sabe: Combine two Lightsabers in a crafting table to create a double-bladed saber.
advancements.lightsabersfork.combat_mast: Defeat enemies, parry attacks, or hone your forms through training with an active Lightsaber to earn Ability Points.
advancements.lightsabersfork.find_holocr: Recover an ancient Holocron from stronghold libraries or the deepest ruins.
advancements.lightsabersfork.jedi_first_: Choose the path of serenity and unlock your first Jedi Force power.
advancements.lightsabersfork.jedi_all_sk: Embrace the teachings of the Light Side and ascend to the rank of Jedi Master.
advancements.lightsabersfork.jedi_grandm: Master every tier of the Light Side and lead the Jedi Order.
advancements.lightsabersfork.sith_first_: Give in to your emotions and unlock your first Dark Side power.
advancements.lightsabersfork.sith_all_sk: Study the dark arts of deception and destruction to become a Sith Master.
advancements.lightsabersfork.sith_empero: Bend the galaxy to your will and claim the throne as Sith Emperor.
advancements.lightsabersfork.elixir_resp: Brew and drink a Purification Elixir to reshape your connection to the Force.
Master both the Light as Grand Master and the Dark as Emperor to bring balance to the Force.
